title: Siman 431
section: Not to Be Stubborn About Anything

segments.he: מְאד. עַל-כֵּן אֲנִי יוֹדֵעַ הַכּל מִקּדֶם כַּנַּ"ל, הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ יְרַחֵם עָלֵינוּ בִּזְכוּתוֹ וִיבַטֵּל כָּל הַגְּזֵרוֹת, וְיַהֲפךְ הַכּל לְטוֹבָה:
segments.en:
(2.) One who wants to sleep and cannot sleep — the advice for this is not to force oneself so much to sleep. For the more one forces oneself to sleep — the more the obstacles to sleep overpower him. And this matter applies also to all things in the world — not to force oneself too much. For the more one forces oneself for something — the more the opposite overwhelms him specifically.

And even in the service of G-d one sometimes needs this — not to force oneself...
